purpose: Teach: 親しく/ノック/バレンタイン/小児科/丸ごと/ひととき/救っ/かなわ

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お友達と、親しくなれたよ、転校先で、ぼく、嬉しいんだ。
lines.en: Mom — I made a friend at my new school. I'm really happy about it.
lines.style: Bright, eager opening with natural childlike pacing. Soft pride in the voice without trying to impress. Slight lift at the end, seeking her approval and warmth.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。お父さんが、ノックの音、してくれたわよ、もうすぐ、帰宅ね。
lines.en: Yes. Your dad's knocking at the door — he'll be home soon.
lines.style: Warm acknowledgment, gently redirecting attention. Soft, present tone. The ease of someone who listens while doing something else. Slight lift toward the end, as if checking in.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 今年のバレンタイン、ぼく、誰にあげようかな、迷ってるよ、ママ。
lines.en: Mom, I'm not sure who to give my Valentine chocolate to this year.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly hesitant pacing. Genuine uncertainty in the voice — not performative worry. Soft, conversational, like he's thinking out loud with someone he trusts.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 熱、出てきたかな、翔くん、明日、小児科、行きましょうね。
lines.en: Sho, do you have a fever? We should go to the pediatrician tomorrow.
lines.style: Shift to gentle concern. Closer listening attention now. Not alarmed, but noticing. Soft firmness on the instruction — practical care masked as light suggestion.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃんの梅干し、丸ごと、食べちゃったよ、ぼく、すっぱかった!
lines.en: I ate Grandpa's whole pickled plum. It was so sour!
lines.style: Quick, surprised laugh in the opening. Bright, slightly sheepish energy — the admission of small mischief. Wry satisfaction on 'sour' — he did it, and he's own the consequence.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 家族でゆっくり、ひととき、過ごす時間、本当に、大切ね、翔くん。
lines.en: Spending time together like this with the whole family — it's really precious, isn't it, Sho.
lines.style: Tender, reflective pause before speaking. Slow pace, as if noticing the moment while it happens. Warmth that doesn't try too hard. Slight trailing-off, like she's speaking partly to herself.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 子犬を、救ったお話、絵本で、読んだよ、感動したんだ、ぼく、本当に。
lines.en: I read a picture book about saving a puppy. It really moved me.
lines.style: Animated, genuine emotion in the voice. Soft but clear — not performing excitement, but sharing something that touched him. Earnest delivery, slightly breathless on the feeling.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お母さんに、かなわないって、お父さん、言ってたわよ、料理、上手だって。
lines.en: Your dad was saying he can't match you in the kitchen — that you're really good at cooking.
lines.style: Reflective, almost playful observation. Warm gaze toward Sho. Soft pride in the delivery, like sharing a small secret. Gentle close, lingering slightly on the compliment.
